manifestations.description: still suffers from pain over his right wrist from time to time
weakness of his right hand, both on grip and pinch
numbness and stiffness of the right hand on morning, requiring exercise for a few minutes to improve the condition

comparable_cases.case_name: Sin sau mui v. Yuen sai kwong
comparable_cases.injury_description: a displaced Colles fracture of her right wrist treated by close reduction and immobilisation in a plaster cast for three months. Left with weakness in the right hand grip and some deformity and tenderness of the right wrist joint. Dr. David Lee assessed her permanent disability at 10% and a loss of earning capacity of 99%.
